Noah: Quick thread  need a tight benchmark narrative for launch: hero, blog, and webinar. Focus: latency vs token economics, keep claims scoped.
Sam: For hero copy short options: 'Faster responses. Lower cost.' or 'Latency you feel, price you control.' Lean first.
Ivy: Proposed charts: 1) p99 latency bars (our vs typical open runtimes) 2) tokens-per-dollar heatmap by seq_len & batch. Minimal labels + concise captions.
Tej: Webinar plan: 20m demo (routing + KV caching) + 15m Q/A. Gated whitepaper with appendix and CSVs. Use sign-up field 'primary_goal' (latency|cost|security).
Sam: Design: two-panel hero with p99 bars + tokens/$ sparkline. I'll mock SVG + PNG.
ops-bot: Shared read link to /bench/2026/data (read-only). Event bench_signup added with field interest_tag.
growth: Routing rules: utm_term=latency -> tag=SLA; utm_term=cost -> tag=ECON. If trial_tokens>300k -> notify AE.
Ivy: Blog ladder: problem, measurement approach, engineering levers (routing/batching/quant), results & caveats. Appendix: pseudocode + exact bench configs.
Noah: Owners: Sam = hero comps, Ivy = blog + appendix, Tej = webinar logistics, growth = lead mapping. Review Thursday 11am PT. Keep numeric claims as 'in our tests' + link to appendix.
Sam: Will push first comps by EOD tomorrow.
Tej: I'll draft the gated form and automated SFDC mapping.
Noah: Perfect. Closing and will reopen after comps.
